payout_quote: Earn up to $250 + Exclusive Perks Just for Banking Smarter. Pick Your Bundle & Your Bonus: Essential - Checking + Savings - $100*. To qualify for the bonus, all accounts in your chosen bundle must meet the minimum deposit requirement within the first 45 days of opening ($500 in either checking or savings at the Essential tier). Debit card and direct deposit are required for all bundles to receive the bonus and must be initiated within the first 45-days. Bonuses will be credited within 60 days of meeting qualifications. Account closure within the first 6 months may result in forfeiture of the account bonus.
steps: Become a member of Commodore Perry Federal Credit Union (Ohio) and open the Essential bundle: Checking + Savings for a $100 cash reward
Fund $500 in either checking or savings within the first 45 days of opening
Activate the debit card and initiate direct deposit within the first 45 days
Keep all accounts open at least 6 months; the bonus is credited within 60 days of meeting the qualifications
catches: Only the $100 Essential tier (checking + savings) is claimed here; the higher Empower ($150) and Excel ($250) tiers require opening a 12+ month certificate (and money market), locking funds long-term - excluded as fund lock-up
